europe_now.title: Italian Privacy Fine on Meta
europe_now.summary: Italian authorities have imposed an 805 million euro fine on Meta regarding privacy violations tied to the access of user photographs.

europe_now.title: Protests and Unrest in France
europe_now.summary: Widespread demonstrations and anti-government actions have continued across France, marking another major wave of public unrest.

top_stories.title: Ukraine Territorial Proposals and Security Discussions
top_stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that international partners suggested Ukraine could cede the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership. He also noted that any final security arrangement resulting from these discussions could potentially be put to a national referendum.

top_stories.title: Anti-Corruption Investigation in Hungary
top_stories.summary: Hungarian authorities uncovered nearly 20 million euros in hidden and buried cash during an ongoing corruption probe involving an Orbán-era minister. The discovery highlights significant financial irregularities currently being targeted by investigators in the country.
